title: Configure production release branch and deploy pipeline
author: alex.leaver
body: Production deployment pipeline has been configured in GitHub Actions. The production environment is configured to deploy exclusively from the release-v2.1 branch upon tag push. Any hotfix must be merged into release-v2.1 before triggering deployment.

comments.author: jamie.dev
comments.body: Confirmed that GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` triggers on push to release-v2.1.

title: Migrate core persistence layer from MongoDB to PostgreSQL
author: alex.leaver
body: We decided to migrate the entire database from MongoDB Atlas to PostgreSQL on Supabase. Completed migration script for user records and project documents.

comments.author: morgan.lead
comments.body: Migration executed smoothly. Notice: no rationale or benchmark comparison was documented in the architecture decision record for why PostgreSQL was chosen over MongoDB.

title: CRITICAL: Auth token signature verification vulnerability in webhook handler
author: priya.security
body: Security audit flagged that incoming external webhook signatures are not verified against the secret hash when header X-Webhook-Legacy is present. Requires urgent patch before next public release. Currently unassigned.

title: Intermittent timeout failures in Stripe checkout webhooks
author: jamie.dev
body: Recurring issue: Webhooks from Stripe for subscription renewals time out after 10000ms because there is no automated retry queue and heavy DB lock occurs on the invoices table.

comments.author: alex.leaver
comments.body: Temporary workaround was restarting the worker pod manually. A durable BullMQ or PG-boss queue is needed.
